policy.instruction: Review the natural-language intent, acceptable entry files and source evidence without rankings. Amend or reject unsuitable candidates. Do not approve solely because a source symbol exists.
policy.existingProbe: docs/baselines/semantic-retrieval-probe-v1.json contains the 24 Flask/Express candidates. Their source anchors were checked, but they remain subject to this same Human review.
policy.splitRule: The complete rails and kubernetes corpora are unseen holdouts. The original v1 16 holdout queries are demoted to development per v2 §2 (they participated in V3 repair and route decisions). All other candidates are development until a separate frozen release manifest is approved.
policy.artifactScope: Candidate labels only; no product integration, model selection, corpus tuning, or achieved recall is implied.
